title_sq: Prane Zogut te Zi, Tek "Lion 2 Residence", Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Me Orientim Perfekt!!
description_sq: Prane Zogut te Zi, Tek "Lion Residences 2", Shitet apartament 2+1+2 Me Orientim Perfekt!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 4 banim te nje kompleksi te ri 37-katesh ne faze ndertimi. Lion 2 Residence eshte nje projekt multifunksional shume afer qendres se qytetit me nje fasade teresisht ekologjike dhe te gjelberuar. Pozicionimi i kompleksit prane rruges kryesore e ben lehtesisht te aksesueshem dhe te pershtatshem si per investim ashtu edhe per banim. Zona ofron te gjitha sherbimet e nevojshme. Apartamenti ka orientim Jug-Lindje cka i mundeson ndricim natyral gjate gjithe dites. Organizimi i brendshem eshte si me poshte: hyrja me korridor, salloni i ndenjes i bollshem me dalje ne ballkon i cili te ofron pamje fantastike nga qendra e qytetit, kendi i gatimit i vecuar, dhoma matrimoniale me tualet te dedikuar dhe me dalje ne ballkon, nje dhome gjumi tjeter dhe tualeti i dites.
title_en: Near the Black Bird, at "Lion 2 Residence", 2+1+2 Apartment for Sale with Perfect Orientation!!
description_en: Near the Black Bird, at "Lion Residences 2", 2+1+2 apartment for sale with perfect orientation!! The apartment is located on the 4th residential floor of a new 37-storey complex under construction. Lion 2 Residence is a multifunctional project very close to the city center with a completely ecological and green facade. The positioning of the complex near the main road makes it easily accessible and suitable for both investment and residence. The area offers all the necessary services. The apartment has a South-East orientation, which enables natural lighting throughout the day. The internal organization is as follows: entrance with corridor, spacious living room with access to the balcony which offers a fantastic view of the city center, separate kitchen area, matrimonial room with dedicated toilet and access to the balcony, another bedroom and the day toilet.
